name: @genoffice/project-web
description: GenOffice Project web host (PROJECT-028) — the browser shell over the shared @genoffice/project-host binding: the web transport bridge (bounded File API reads, Blob-download saves, the DOM discard dialog, the beforeunload close guard, drag-and-drop opens) and the DOM menu bar, mounting the SAME controller/DOM/translation binding the desktop shell runs against the canonical engine, scheduler, and file adapters. The browser-side implementation imports NO Node/Electron API (architecture-lock §3 — enforced structurally by the discipline suite and the built-bundle scan in CI). NOT a foundation package.
